subject: Medford High School MSBA Statement of Interest
overview: The committee met to formally authorize the submission of a Statement of Interest to the Massachusetts School Building Authority for Medford High School. This procedural vote adopts state-mandated language required to seek potential funding for comprehensive school renovations or replacement.

items.title: MSBA Statement of Interest Authorization
items.summary: Approved a resolution authorizing the Superintendent to submit a Statement of Interest to the MSBA Core Program to address infrastructure, safety, and accessibility deficiencies at Medford High School. Administration clarified that the vote uses specific state-required templates to formally enter the grant application pipeline for potential renovation or new construction.
